main_body: A wide wooden counter or shelf unit (rows 6-17) with three dark recessed compartments holding small items (orange goods). Separate wooden plank strips sit above (rows 0-5) and below (rows 19-24), with grey background between them.
top_band: Mid-brown rows 6-8 at the top of the main body, about 2-3 rows, the same tone family as the front. It does not read as a horizontal surface seen from above.
evidence: In the middle column the top of the main body is a thin brown rim of 2-3 rows. It merges straight into the front face, which is a flat panel with recessed compartments. There is no lighter top surface and no distinct front-edge highlight. The eave shadow is only the dark opening tops, not a shade under an overhang. The extra plank strips above and below are separate horizontal bars drawn face-on. The whole piece reads as a front elevation with a thin rim.

style.evidence: The wood has about 4 tones (dark brown, mid brown, light tan, orange accent) and some grain dots. The outlines are dark brown, which suits the material. The planks are fairly uniform bands, and the piece is less richly shaded than the stall and well references, which have more steps, per-material highlights and more varied tiles. It also looks like a disjointed set of strips, which reads thinner than the references.
